summary_1line: After Bharata conquers the Gandharvas and founds cities for his sons, Rama establishes Lakshmana’s sons Angada and Chandraketu as kings in new realms.

image_candidates.scene_text: A battlefield runs with rivers of blood and floating corpses as Bharata’s mantra-charged Samvarta weapon annihilates the Gandharva host.
Rama, surrounded by his brothers, anoints the young princes Angada and Chandraketu in a royal coronation ceremony.
The newly built city of Angadiya rises with fortified walls, temples, and groves of Tala, Tamala, and Bakula trees shining under the sun.
